source:
Ana: We should switch the whole fleet to the new tires this quarter. I am certain about this.
Bo: Absolutely not. We should keep the current tires until next year.
Ana: We should switch now.
Bo: We should wait.

extraction.mainQuestion: Should the fleet switch to the new tires this quarter?

positions.label: Switch this quarter
positions.thesis: The whole fleet should switch to the new tires this quarter.
positions.steelman: Ana states the conclusion firmly but gives no reason in the text.

groundingQuotes.quote: We should switch the whole fleet to the new tires this quarter.

positions.label: Keep the current tires until next year
positions.thesis: The fleet should keep its current tires until next year.
positions.steelman: Bo states the conclusion firmly but gives no reason in the text.

groundingQuotes.quote: We should keep the current tires until next year.

caveats: Both speakers state opposite conclusions and repeat them. No reason, evidence, or shared premise appears, so no claim can be mapped and no crux can be established.
